issues.description: The problem statement contains a contradictory specification for the SealSaloon.stock attribute: one section instructs to initialize a final Stock in the constructor (instance field initialized at construction), while a later section explicitly requires the stock attribute to be static and shared across all instances. This contradiction can confuse students about whether to implement stock as an instance final field or a static (possibly final) field.
issues.suggestedFix: Clarify the specification: decide whether stock is an instance final field initialized in the constructor or a static (shared) field. Update the problem statement to state explicitly (for example) "private static final Stock stock = new Stock();" if stock should be shared, and instruct students to provide a static getter. Alternatively, remove the note requiring static and describe instance behavior consistently.

issues.description: The problem statement/UML specifies orderMeal(Meal): void, but the solution implements orderMeal returning boolean. This is a method return type mismatch between specification and solution and will confuse students about the expected signature and return behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the signature consistent. Either update the problem statement/UML to allow boolean orderMeal(Meal) (and document the meaning of the return value), or change the solution (and any tests) so orderMeal is void and performs the same side effects (add the meal, increment totalOrders, call checkOrderReady()) without returning a value.
